title: The Antique brass clock
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：antique　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 antique 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the keeper wrote of ① an antique brass clock in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② more antique than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the antique ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most antique brass clock anybody in the tower had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1963 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too antique to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the antique ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an antique trade in old paper, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as antique as the trade in old paper they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was antique or not, and he said so.

By 1976 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something antique, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite antique; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the antique ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1979, in the rain, she wrote of another antique brass clock in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more antique than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most antique trade in old paper in the whole tower, she said in 1981, was the one she could never quite name; the antique ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 古旧（前置定语 an antique brass clock：1969 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件古旧的铜钟）
B. adj. 古旧／古董（比较级 more antique than：文中两处，一处比铜钟，一处比预想）
C. adj. 古旧／古董（最高级 the most antique：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 古旧（表语 too antique to do：母亲觉得它太古旧，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 古董（前置定语 an antique trade in old paper：叔叔把整件事称作一桩古董的旧纸生意）
F. adj. 古董（同级比较 as antique as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩旧纸生意相比）
G. adj. 古董（后置定语 something antique：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 古董（受程度副词修饰 quite antique：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: the most antique brass clock anybody
an antique trade in old paper
The most antique trade in old paper in

answers.why: antique 意为“古旧”，1969 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件古旧的铜钟”，此处作前置定语 an antique brass clock。
antique 意为“古旧”，此处用比较级 more antique than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
antique 意为“古旧”，年历上 一月 那行字说它是钟楼里最古旧的一件，故用最高级 the most antique brass clock。
antique 意为“古旧”，母亲认为这件东西“太古旧了，谁也用不上”，too antique to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
antique 意为“古董”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩古董的旧纸生意”，此处作前置定语 an antique trade in old paper。
antique 意为“古董”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩旧纸生意一样古董”，同级比较用 as antique as。
antique 意为“古董”，年历上那半行字要的是“古董的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something antique。
antique 意为“古董”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当古董”，quite 修饰原级 antique。
antique 意为“古董”，1979 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要古董”，故用比较级 more antique than。
antique 意为“古董”，母亲 1981 年说的是“整个钟楼里最古董的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most antique trade in old paper。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件古旧的铜钟。（an antique brass clock）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更古旧。（more antique than …）
母亲觉得它太古旧，谁也用不上。（too antique to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩古董的旧纸生意。（an antique trade in old paper）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩旧纸生意一样古董。（as antique as …）
到了 1976 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件古董的东西。（something antique）
answers: In 1969 the keeper wrote of an antique brass clock in the calendar.
Everybody said it was more antique than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too antique to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an antique trade in old paper.
He said nobody would call it as antique as the trade in old paper they had once had.
By 1976 the calendar asked for nothing but something antique.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 antique 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1969 the keeper wrote of an antique brass clock in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most antique brass clock in the tower, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too antique to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an antique trade in old paper, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite antique, and everybody laughed.
The antique ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
